method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 37, compilation date 4 June 2026 (includes amendments: Act No. 75, 2025; register id C2026C00236), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2007A00020.txt (retrieved 2026-09-22); with the Australian Citizenship Regulation 2016, Compilation No. 23, compilation date 1 July 2026 (register id F2026C00596; ss 6, 9, 10, 16 and Schedule 3), and the Australian Citizenship (Transitionals and Consequentials) Act 2007, Compilation No. 5, compilation date 1 July 2015 (register id C2015C00383; Schedule 3 items 1 and 4), as deposited in their own subject folders

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the child born in or outside Australia and the applicant for conferral (and the citizen asking about renunciation). The old Act (ss 2, 4), permanent residence (s 5), citizenship by birth (s 12, with Transitionals Act Sch 3 item 4), citizenship by descent (ss 16-19A, Regulation s 6), conferral: general eligibility and the test (s 21(2), (2A)), the general residence requirement (s 22), the Minister's decision (s 24), cancellation for want of a pledge (s 25(3), Regulation s 9), the pledge (ss 26-27, Regulation s 10) and the day citizenship begins (ss 20, 28), renunciation (s 33), and fees for descent, conferral and renunciation applications (s 46, Regulation s 16 and Schedule 3: $380, $595, $320). Not encoded: the 1948 Act (its answers are inputs), ss 7-8, 13-15, Subdivisions AA and C, s 16(3), s 21(3)-(8) beyond pledge exemptions and fees, ss 22A-23A, s 22(4A), ss 25(4) and 28(3)-(4), ss 34-36L, Part 2 Divisions 4-5, Part 3 and fee refunds.
seat: the child born in or outside Australia (citizenship by birth s 12, by descent s 16) and the applicant for citizenship by conferral (ss 21-28); the citizen asking about renunciation (s 33)
